message.content: {"summary":"You present a coherent Australian reef-monitoring concept and address most required mission-design topics. Your STK material and report structure provide a useful foundation. To strengthen the design, validate payload performance and launch feasibility, correct orbital and end-of-life claims, and support conclusions with complete, consistently cited evidence.","criteria":{"C1":"In the Introduction, you explain the reef-monitoring purpose, Australian rationale, single-spacecraft choice, and intended users such as CSIRO and BOM. To strengthen this accomplished work, identify the operator and customer roles more precisely, including who commands the spacecraft and uses its products.","C2":"Your Launch, Orbit, Ground Control & Communications, and Mission Duration & EOL sections cover most requirements and include useful STK access results. For the accomplished level, substantiate an available launcher and payload performance, correct the RAAN and sunlight reasoning, support contact and data-link claims, and reconcile the deorbit plan with the stated lack of thrust.","C3":"Your Conclusion recaps the configuration and notes uncertainty about the Vega E launch. To reach accomplished, draw specific conclusions from the access and orbital results, and state how unresolved feasibility issues affect whether the mission can meet its monitoring goals.","C4":"Your report has an Executive Summary, clear section headings, and generally understandable prose. For the accomplished level, improve wording, consistently number and caption figures and tables, and ensure every in-text citation matches a complete reference; replace Wikipedia and add bibliography entries for citations [49]–[74]."},"next_steps":["Specify the sensor, ground sample distance, spectral capability, swath, and evidence that the proposed imagery can support reef monitoring at 600 km.","Rework the Orbit and EOL analyses: state the local solar time, determine RAAN from injection conditions, and provide a feasible disposal design and decay-time estimate.","Validate the launch and communications assumptions, then revise the Conclusion to assess results and limitations; complete and consistently format all citations, figures, and tables."]}
